sentiment: Sometimes the old and plain is enough — what we call simple still holds a quiet treasure.

stories.title: The Lost Treasure of Sid Meier's Pirates
stories.summary: A lost, unfinished gem of a game calls back to how a plain old treasure can still hold wonder.

stories.title: We Rebuilt the Linux MicroVM Stack on Apple Silicon
stories.summary: Rebuilding what seemed settled shows that even old foundations can be quietly remade.

stories.title: HTML Can Do That
stories.summary: The plainest of tools silently does more than we give it credit for — a quiet kind of treasure.
